The '''72 twin auto-blaster''' was manufactured by [[Gyrhil/Legends|Gyrhil]]. The [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]] [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] incorporated one twin [[autoblaster]] mounted beneath the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] as part of its weapons systems.<ref name="EGVV" />
